{{Top}}
'''Warlords''' were the male leaders of a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] clan. The position of '''Clan Warlord''' was bestowed upon a male by way of marriage to the most powerful female, the clan [[Matron/Legends|Matron]].

==Known warlords==
*[[Vrokk]]&mdash;Clan Warlord of [[Bolgoink clan]]
*[[Lugh/Legends|Lugh]]&mdash;Second Warlord of Bolgoink clan
*[[Rog]]&mdash;Warlord of [[Nudskutch]] region
*[[Ugbuz]]&mdash;Clan Warlord of [[Gakfedd tribe|Gakfedd clan]]
*[[Krok]]&mdash;Warlord of Gakfedd clan
*[[Kinfarg]]&mdash;Warlord of [[Klagg tribe|Klagg clan]]
